spans.s: निचक्र नि-चक्र, अस्, m., N. of a prince.
निचङ्कुण नि-चङ्कुण for नि-चुङ्कुण, q. v.
निचङ्कुण नि-चङ्कुण for नि-चुङ्कुण, q. v.
निचन्द्र नि-चन्द्र, अस्, m., N. of a Dānava.

निचमन नि-चमन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. चम् with
नि), sipping, taking liquid into the mouth.
निचय नि-चय. See under 1. नि-चि below.

नि-चय, अस्, m. piling up, heaping up; collection,
heap, multitude, quantity, store, stock, provisions (e. g.
षण्-मास-निचय, provisioned for six months);
assemblage, assemblage or collection of parts con-
stituting a whole (e. g. शरीर-निचय, the assem-
blage of parts of which the body consists; वधू-
निचय, a collection of women); certainty, ascertain-
ment (in this sense for निश्-चय, q. v.).
नि-चाय्य, ind. having seen, having observed.
नि-चाय, अस्, m. a heap (as a measure).

निचाय् नि-चाय्, cl. 1. P. -चायति, &c. (oc-
curring only in the form नि-चाय्य), Ved. to regard with
reverence, honour, worship; to see; [cf. rt. 4. चि.]

निचि 1. नि-चि, cl. 5. P. A. -चिनोति, -चिनुते,
-चेतुम्, to pile up, heap up.

निचि 2. नि-चि, cl. 3. P. -चिकेति, -चिकाय,
&c., Ved. to observe, perceive, recognise: Desid.,
Ved. -चिकीषते, to observe, watch, guard.

नि-चयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, heaped up, containing a
quantity, full of, abounding in.

नि-चित, अस्, आ, अम्, piled up, heaped up, full of,
filled; covered, overspread; raised up; (आस्), m. pl.,
N. of a warrior-tribe [cf. नैचित्य]; (आ), f., N. of
a river.

नि-चेकाय, अस्, m. (fr. the Intens.), continual or
repeated piling up.
नि-चेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be piled or heaped up.

नि-चिर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. attentive, observant,
vigilant; (आ), m. du. epithet of Mitra-Varuṇa; (Sāy.)
excessively ancient (= नितरां चिरन्तनौ).
निचिर नि-चिर. See under 2. नि-चि above.

नि-चेतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. an observer; observing,
paying attention.

निचिकी निचिकी, f. an excellent cow (=
नैचिकी, q. v.).

निचुङ्कुण नि-चुङ्कुण, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. Intens.
of rt. कुण्?), Ved. roaring, murmuring; (अस्), m.,
N. of a Vāruṇi; (often read नि-चङ्कुण or नि-
चाङ्कुण.)

निचुम्पुण नि-चुम्पुण, अस्, आ, अम्, (rt. चुप्?),
Ved. an epithet of Soma (because, according to Yāska,
निचमनेन प्रीणाति); of the Ava-bhṛtha; of the sea
(because, according to Yāska, निचमनेन पूर्यते);
moving about?; (अस्), m., N. of a Śaunaḥśepha.

निचुल नि-चुल, अस्, m. (fr. rt. चुल् with नि),
the tree Barringtonia Acutangula, commonly called
Hijjal, = वेतस; = नि-चोल, an upper garment, over-
coat; (also read नि-चूल.)

नि-चुलक, अम्, n. an outer garment; a breast-
plate, a cuirass.
नि-चोल, अस्, m. a cover, wrapper, veil, surtout.

नि-चोलक, अस्, m. a sort of jacket, bodice, mantle,
but especially a soldier's jacket serving as a cuirass or
breast-plate; (अम्), n. = नि-चुलक.

निचृत् 1. नि-चृत्, cl. 6. P. -चृतति, -चर्ति-
तुम्, to insert, infix, fix into.

2. नि-चृत्, त्, f. a defective metre; [cf. अति-न्˚,
नि-वृत्.]

निचेरु नि-चेरु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. rt. चर् with नि),
Ved. gliding; creeping; an epithet of the Ava-bhṛtha.

निच्छवि निच्छवि, इस्, f., N. of a district (=
तीर-भुक्ति), the modern Tirhut; [cf. लिच्छवि.]
निच्छिद्र नि-च्छिद्र for निश्-छिद्र, q. v.

निच्छिवि निच्छिवि, इस्, m., N. of one of the
degraded castes sprung from the outcast or Vrātya
Kṣatriyas (see Manu

; their occupation appears
to have been the public exhibition of gymnastic
performances &c., as they are classed with the
Jhallas, Mallas, and others).

निच्छेद नि-च्छेद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. छिद् with
नि), cutting off; (in arithmetic) leaving no common
measure, reduced by the common divisor to the least
term so as not to allow of further reduction (in
this sense for निश्-छेद).

नीच नीच, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. नि + अञ्च्, cf. उच्च;
said to be fr. rt. चि with नि), low, not high, short,
little, small, dwarfish; deep, lowered (as the voice),
pronounced without an accent; situated below, being
in a low position; low, vile, insignificant, inferior,
base, mean (as a man or action); (अस्), m. a kind
of perfume (= चोरक); (अम्), n. (in astrology) the
lowest point of a planet (= ταπείνωμα), the seventh
house from the highest point; (आत्), ind. from below,
from beneath; [cf. नीचैस्, उच्च-नीच, न्य्-अञ्च्.]
—नी-
च-कदम्ब, अस्, m., N. of a plant (= मण्डीरी).
—नीच-कुल, अम्, n. a low family.
—नीच-ग, अस्,
आ, अम्, going low or downwards, descending (as a
river); being in or belonging to a low man or
to a low class of men; low, vile, base; (आ), f. a
river; (अम्), n. water.
—नीच-गत, अस्, आ, अम्
being at the lowest point (as a planet).
—नीच-
गृह, अम्, n. (in astrology) the house or station of
the heavens in which a planet stands at its lowest
point.
—नीच-जाति, इस्, इस्, इ, of low birth.
—निच-ता,
f. or नीच-त्व, अम्, n. (opposed to उच्च-ता), lowness,
meanness, vileness, baseness, humbleness, inferiority,
a low situation.
—नीच-भोज्य, अस्, m. ‘the food of
low men,’ an onion.
—नीच-मेढ्र, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. one whose penis hangs low.
—नीच-योनिन्, ई,
इनी, इ, being of low origin, low-born.
—नीच-रत,
अस्, आ, अम्, delighting in mean things.
—नीचर्क्ष
(˚च-ऋक्˚), अम्, n. (?) = नीच-गृह, q. v.
—नीच-
वज्र, अम्, n. an inferior diamond, a sort of gem (=
वैक्रान्त).
—नीचा-वयस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. one
whose strength has failed; (Sāy.) bending down the
body.
—नीचोक्ति (˚च-उक्˚), इस्, f. a low or vulgar
expression.
—नीचोच्च-वृत्त (˚च-उच्˚), अम्, n. an
epicycle.
—नीचोपगत (˚च-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, situ-
ated low in the sky.

नीचा, ind. low, below, down, downwards, (this word
may be regarded as the inst. c. of न्य्-अञ्च्, q. v.)

नीचक, अस्, इका, अम्, low, short, dwarfish; (low
as the voice), soft; vile, mean; (अका), f. an excel-
lent cow; (अकी), f. the head of an ox.

नीचकिन्, ई, m. the head or top of anything, the head
of an ox; the owner of a good cow; [cf. नैचिक.]

नीचकैस्, ind. (diminutive of नीचैस्), low, below,
little, &c.
नीचात्, ind. from below. See नीच.

नीचायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. descending, flying
down (as a falcon).

नीची-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्,
to lower, to pronounce without an accent.

नीचीन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being low or below,
low, directed downwards or underneath, hanging
down, flowing down, cast down.
—नीचीन-बार, अस्,
आ, अम्, Ved. having its opening below (as a cloud).

नीचैस्, ind. low, below, down, downwards, under-
neath, beneath, deeply, deep, in the depths, in a
bent or inclined position, bowing low, humbly,
modestly; with a low or depressed or deep tone of
voice, in a low tone (i. e. अन्-उदात्त, q. v.), softly;
short, small, little, dwarfish; N. of a mountain, also
called वामन-गिरि and खर्व (Dwarfish); [cf.
उच्चैस्, निम्नैस्, शनैस्.]
—नीचैः-कर, अस्, आ
or ई, अम्, causing a low or deep tone, giving depth
of voice.
—नीचैर्-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, with down-
cast countenance.
—नीचैस्-तराम्, ind. in a low
tone, softly.

1. नीच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, living below; Ved. an epithet
of some nations in the West.

2. नीच्य, Nom. P. नीच्यति, &c., to be in a low
situation, be a slave.
